description: MCP server for Google Search Console — analyze search performance, inspect URL indexing and manage sitemaps from an AI app

client_secret.title: Client secret

site_url.description: The property EXACTLY as registered in Search Console. tool_signatures.description: Runs a Search Analytics (performance) query for a property: clicks, impressions, CTR and average position from Google Search, grouped by the requested dimensions. Each returned row has keys[] (one val

operator.description: Comparison operator; the regex operators use RE2 syntax (an invalid regex returns a 400).

dimension.description: Which dimension this filter tests (need not be in the grouping dimensions).

expression.description: The value or RE2 pattern to match against.

filters.description: Row filters, ALL combined with AND — the API has no OR across filters (run separate queries instead).

end_date.description: Last date of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific Time, inclusive.

A mismatched value returns 403/404; list_sites shows the exact registered values.

row_limit.description: Max rows to return (1..25000; API default 1000).

start_row.description: 0-based row offset for pagination (default 0). A response with no rows means the end.

data_state.description: "final" (default) — only finalized data; "all" — include fresh data still subject to change; "hourly_all" — required when grouping by hour (recent data only).

dimensions.description: How to group rows; keys[] in each row follows this order. "country" values are ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes, "device" is DESKTOP/MOBILE/TABLET, "hour" requires data_state "hourly_all". Omit for one totals row.

start_date.description: First date of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific Time.

search_type.description: Which search surface to report: "web" (default), "image", "video", "news" (News tab of search), "discover" (Discover feed), "googleNews" (news.google.com and the app). discover/googleNews support a reduced dimension set — an unsupported combination returns the API's 400 verbatim.

aggregation_type.description: How metrics are aggregated: "auto" (default) lets the API decide, "byPage"/"byProperty" force it, "byNewsShowcasePanel" is for News Showcase. Affects how clicks/impressions are counted, not which rows exist.
